title: Reefer Cargo Services: Inspection and Cancellation Fee Schedule
content:
This schedule gives, for each Reefer Cargo Services tier, the price of a pre-trip inspection of the allocated reefer, the price of a repeat inspection once an earlier one has lapsed, the number of calendar days an inspection stays usable for plugging the unit in, and the fee for withdrawing a service after its inspection. All amounts are in US dollars.

| Tier | Inspection fee (per inspection) | Repeat inspection fee (per inspection) | Inspection usable for plug-in (calendar days) | Fee for cancelling after inspection (per service) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Reefer Standard | 75.00 | 60.00 | 30 | 0.00 |
| AHL Reefer Monitored | 85.00 | 70.00 | 30 | 0.00 |
| AHL Reefer Cold Treatment | 95.00 | 80.00 | 14 | 150.00 |
| AHL Reefer Controlled Atmosphere | 110.00 | 95.00 | 14 | 250.00 |
| AHL Reefer Pharma GDP | 150.00 | 130.00 | 7 | 200.00 |
| AHL Reefer Superfreezer | 180.00 | 160.00 | 14 | 300.00 |

## Notes on the columns

- The repeat inspection fee is the lower of the two inspection prices on every tier, and it is the price that applies to an inspection carried out again because the earlier one is no longer usable.
- The usable period is a count of calendar days after the inspection within which the unit may go onto terminal power without being inspected anew.
- The cancellation column is a charge that comes on top of the inspection already charged; on Standard and Monitored it stands at 0.00.

## Reading the schedule (hypothetical tier look-ups)

- A Pharma GDP reefer inspected and then withdrawn carries, from this schedule alone, one inspection at 150.00 and a withdrawal fee of 200.00.
- On the Controlled Atmosphere tier a second inspection is priced at 95.00, fifteen dollars below the first.
